aka.ms","user":{"login":"IanFrelinger","id":16062048,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjE2MDYyMDQ4","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/16062048?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger","html_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"labels":[],"state":"closed","locked":false,"assignees":[],"milestone":null,"comments":0,"created_at":"2026-10-25T19:18:21Z","updated_at":"2026-10-25T20:15:50Z","closed_at":"2026-10-25T20:15:47Z","assignee":null,"author_association":"OWNER","active_lock_reason":null,"draft":false,"pull_request":{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pulls/876","html_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/876","diff_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/876.diff","patch_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/876.patch","merged_at":"2026-10-25T20:15:47Z"},"body":" ## Summary Every CI job is currently red at **Setup .NET**. `actions/setup-dotnet` with a channel (`10.0.x`, or `global-json-file` with `rollForward: latestFeature`) makes dotnet-install resolve the download through aka.ms. Those links now redirect to `dotnetorigin.blob.core.windows.net`, which answers `409 Public access is not permitted on this storage account`. Given an exact version, dotnet-install builds the URL itself and downloads from `builds.dotnet.microsoft.com` (with `ci.dot.net` as fallback), without going through aka.ms. I confirmed this with `dotnet-install.sh --dry-run`: ``` --version 10.0.403 → URL #0 - primary: https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Sdk/10.0.403/... --channel 10.0 → URL #0 - aka.ms: https://dotnetorigin.blob.core.windows.net/dotnet/Sdk/10.0.403/... ``` ## Changes - **setup-dotnet pins:** all 61 `actions/setup-dotnet` steps (43 files: the workflows plus `actions/pr-blockers/action.yml`) now pin exact SDK versions. - SDKs: **10.0.403**, **9.0.320** and **8.0.427**, the versions aka.ms resolves to today, so jobs get the same SDKs as yesterday. - Replaced: `X.Y.x`, `'10.0.x'` and `global-json-file: global.json`. - **Image installs:** the test images also install the .NET 8 runtimes with `--version 8.0.33` instead of `--channel 8.0`. These are `.docker/Dockerfile.test-caching{,-alpine,-debian,-android}`, `.docker/Dockerfile.test-framework`, and `.devcontainer/post-create.sh`. The first CI run on this PR showed the container setup lanes failing at "build container image" for this reason. - **`scripts/readiness-container-setup.sh`:** now installs aspnetcore `--version 8.0.33` too. - **`global.json` stays the source of truth.** It is unchanged. The new checker requires the pin for its band to satisfy `sdk.version` under its `rollForward` policy, so a `global.json` bump that the pins don't meet fails `shell-lint` and names every pin. - **New checker:** `scripts/ci/verify-setup-dotnet-pins.py`. It fails on: - a channel version or `global-json-file`; - a setup-dotnet step with no version; - two different pins in one major.minor band; - no pin for `global.json`'s band; - a pin that `global.json` would not accept; - any `dotnet-install … --channel` under `.docker/`, `.devcontainer/` or `.github/` (continuation lines joined, comments ignored); - an empty scan. - **New test:** `scripts/ci/test-setup-dotnet-pins.py`, with 10 hermetic fixture controls and a population floor on the real tree. - Both scripts are auto-discovered by `scripts/ci/run-repo-gates.sh` and run in the required `shell-lint` check. - Row added to `ci/cert-gate-assertions.md`. - **Docs:** `docs/EnvironmentSetupGate-v1.md` lists the pinned versions; CHANGELOG entry added. ## Testing - `bash scripts/ci/run-repo-gates.sh`: all 43 gates passed locally on the first commit. The checker reports 61 steps with pins `{10.0: 10.0.403, 9.0: 9.0.320, 8.0: 8.0.427}` and says `global.json` is satisfied. - **This PR's CI, first commit:** Setup .NET passed in `build-core` and `cert-gate`. Only the three container setup lanes failed, at the Dockerfile `--channel 8.0` installs that the second commit fixes. - Mutation checks. Each mutation was applied, the test went red, it was restored, the tree was clean, and the test went green again: | Mutation | Result | |---|---| | `policy-ignored` | 1 failing | | `block-never-ends` | 1 failing | | `channel-accepted` | 2 failing | | `global-json-file-allowed` | 1 failing | | `workflow-reverted` (`build-gate.yml` back to `10.0.x`) | 1 failing | | `dockerfile-reverted` (`Dockerfile.test-caching` back to `--channel 8.0`) | 1 failing | | `channel-scan-disabled` | 1 failing | - Every pinned archive answers 200 on `builds.dotnet.microsoft.com`: - SDK 10.0.403 on linux-x64, win-x64 and osx-arm64; - runtime and aspnetcore 8.0.33 on linux-x64, linux-musl-x64 and linux-arm64. ## Known limits - `actions/setup-dotnet` v6 also installs the latest LTS runtime by channel. That step still hits aka.ms, but setup-dotnet treats its failure as a warning, not an error. - **Not changed:** the user-facing installers `scripts/setup/setup-linux.sh` and `scripts/install/quickstart.sh` still use `dotnet-install --channel 10.0`. They only run when no SDK is present, and pinning what end users install is a product decision, not a CI fix. They will fail for users until Microsoft fixes aka.ms. - **SDK bumps are now manual:** pins no longer float to new patch releases. Bumping means editing every pin; the checker names each one. - **Revisit when aka.ms is fixed:** whether to keep the pin is the coordinator's call. ## Checklist - [x] Documentation updated - [x] Not a versioned release — skip
